plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Live session pane (/ctx): context, limits, tool calls, model requests; a one-time note to the model when limits or context cross a threshold

plugins.name: turn-footer
plugins.description: A turn summary under each answer (tools, requests, tokens, cache hit) and the running tool in the spinner

plugins.name: change-ledger
plugins.description: A pane (/changes) listing the files this session edited, beside the git working tree

plugins.name: turn-timeline
plugins.description: A pane (/timeline) drawing the current turn as a timeline of model requests and tool calls per loop

plugins.name: compact-keeper
plugins.description: Save each compaction's summary, session id and edited files to ~/.claude/handoffs

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Draw the mermaid diagrams of each answer as images in a pane (/show-me); needs mmdc and a kitty-graphics terminal

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hide API keys and private keys before the model or the transcript sees them; block reads of credential files and commands that print secrets
